name: Christmas on the Square at CountryWay Town Square
paras: The City of Newberry lists Christmas on the Square for Saturday, December 19, 2026, starting at 6 PM at CountryWay Town Square in Newberry.
The city calendar describes a festive evening with live music, performances, food, shopping and a live nativity, and notes this is the 10th annual celebration.
tip: Newberry also holds its Christmas parade the same evening at 6 PM, so check the start times before choosing one.

name: Newberry Christmas Parade
paras: The City of Newberry calendar lists the NMSO Christmas Parade for Saturday, December 19, 2026 at 6 PM, with Newberry High School shown as the location.
Organizers invite floats to register through an online form, and the listing states there is no registration fee to take part in the parade.
tip: The Newberry parade and Christmas on the Square both begin at 6 PM that evening, so pick one to arrive for first.

name: Christmas Doin's at Marjorie's
venue: Marjorie Kinnan Rawlings Historic State Park
address: 18700 S County Road 325, Cross Creek, FL 32640
paras: Florida State Parks lists Christmas Doin's at Marjorie's for Saturday, December 19, 2026, from 5 PM to 7:30 PM at Marjorie Kinnan Rawlings Historic State Park in Cross Creek.

The park calls it a much-loved annual holiday event with the firing of the grove, festive music and a tour of the main part of the house decorated in typical 1930s fashion. The event is free with park admission of $3.
tip: Park entry is $3 per vehicle, and the farmhouse interior is normally open by guided tour only.
